# Loona QR Codes

> Loona QR Codes is a free QR code generator by Loona Automation with 36 QR code types, plus a free QR and barcode scanner and a bulk QR code generator. Codes have no expiry, need no sign-up and carry no watermark, and everything runs in the visitor's browser — QR codes are generated privately on the visitor's own device.

## QR Code Generators
- [URL / Website QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/url-qr-code-generator/): Turn any website link into a QR code.
- [Plain Text QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/text-qr-code-generator/): Put any text, code or message inside a QR code.
- [WiFi QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/wifi-qr-code-generator/): Guests connect to WiFi with one scan, no password typing.
- [WhatsApp QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/whatsapp-qr-code-generator/): Start a WhatsApp chat with one scan, no number saving.
- [vCard Contact QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/vcard-qr-code-generator/): Scan to save your full contact card to a phone.
- [Email QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/email-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open a pre-addressed email, ready to send.
- [SMS QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/sms-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open a pre-written text message.
- [Phone Call QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/phone-qr-code-generator/): Scan to dial your number instantly.
- [Instagram QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/instagram-qr-code-generator/): Grow followers with a scan-to-follow Instagram QR.
- [Facebook QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/facebook-qr-code-generator/): Send people straight to your Facebook page.
- [YouTube QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/youtube-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open a video or channel instantly.
- [TikTok QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/tiktok-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open your TikTok profile.
- [X (Twitter) QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/x-twitter-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open your X profile.
- [LinkedIn QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/linkedin-qr-code-generator/): Connect professionally with one scan.
- [Telegram QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/telegram-qr-code-generator/): Scan to join your Telegram profile, group or channel.
- [Snapchat QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/snapchat-qr-code-generator/): Scan to add you on Snapchat.
- [Google Maps Location QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/google-maps-location-qr-code-generator/): Scan to get directions to your place.
- [Google Review QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/google-review-qr-code-generator/): Happy customers leave a Google review in seconds.
- [Restaurant Menu QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/restaurant-menu-qr-code-generator/): Contactless menu on every table.
- [PDF QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/pdf-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open or download a PDF file.
- [App Store / Google Play QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/app-store-qr-code-generator/): Scan to install your app.
- [Google Form QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/google-form-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open and fill a Google Form.
- [Zoom / Meeting QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/zoom-meeting-qr-code-generator/): Scan to join a meeting or class.
- [Event / Calendar QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/event-calendar-qr-code-generator/): Scan to save an event to the calendar.
- [PayPal QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/paypal-qr-code-generator/): Get paid: scan to open your PayPal.me page.
- [UPI Payment QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/upi-payment-qr-code-generator/): UPI payment QR for shops in India and UPI regions.
- [JazzCash / EasyPaisa QR Code (Pakistan) Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/jazzcash-easypaisa-qr-code-generator/): Share your JazzCash or EasyPaisa account details as a QR.
- [Bitcoin / Crypto QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/bitcoin-crypto-qr-code-generator/): Share a Bitcoin wallet address as a QR.
- [Spotify / Music QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/spotify-music-qr-code-generator/): Scan to play a song, playlist or podcast.
- [Resume / Portfolio QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/resume-portfolio-qr-code-generator/): Put your resume or portfolio one scan away.
- [Image QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/image-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open or share a photo or image link.
- [Audio QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/audio-qr-code-generator/): Scan to play a song, voice note or audio file.
- [Social Media QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/social-media-qr-code-generator/): One QR for your social media profile links.
- [Pinterest QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/pinterest-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open your Pinterest profile or board.
- [Discord QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/discord-qr-code-generator/): Scan to join your Discord server or profile.
- [GitHub QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/github-qr-code-generator/): Scan to open your GitHub profile or repository.
- [QR Code & Barcode Scanner](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/qr-code-scanner/): Scan codes with your camera, or decode QR codes and barcodes from a photo or screenshot.
- [Bulk QR Code Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-qr-codes/bulk-qr-code-generator/): Create up to 100 labelled QR codes at once in a printable sheet.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All tools are free, need no sign-up, and process data only on the visitor's device.
- Contact: loonaautomation@gmail.com. Publisher: Loona Automation (https://loonaautomation.github.io/).
